name: To8gal Fullslider
author: To8gal - Luca

sections.description:
To8gal Fullslider is a lightweight fullscreen image slider with overlay and a customizable CTA button.

  • Fullscreen Continuous images slides
  • Overlay with adjustable color and opacity
  • CTA button with custom text, URL, and position
  • Simple setup with shortcode usage

Get the Pro Version:

  • Adjustable height
  • Adjustable speed
  • Pause on Hover
  • Shuffle

Want to have more features and Customization? Contact me
sections.installation:
1. Upload the to8gal-fullslider folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Add slides using the “Fullscreen Slides” menu
  4. Insert the slider on a page or post using the [to8gal_fullslider] shortcode
  5. Configure overlay and CTA settings via Settings → Fullscreen Slider
sections.faq:
Can I set custom height or scroll speed?

These options are only available in the pro version.

Can I have an infinite continuous scroll?

This feature is reserved for the pro version.
